newsitem.title: INDIA: India DSP Merrill, Choksey cancel Asian Paints deal.
newsitem.headline: India DSP Merrill, Choksey cancel Asian Paints deal.

text.p: Brokerage firm DSP Merrill Lynch Ltd said on Thursday that a share deal it brokered for the Choksey family of Asian Paints India Ltd has been cancelled.

"The Choksey family and DSP Merrill Lynch Ltd jointly announced today that the block trade of 3.5 million shares of Asian Paints has been cancelled by and between the parties," DSP said in a statement.
It said that the National Stock Exchange (NSE), where the deal was done, has been informed about the cancellation.
The statement did not give details.
Asian Paints managing director Atul Choksey said last week that his family had sold eight percent of their 9.5 percent holding in the firm following disagreements with other directors.
Traders said two foreign funds -- Morgan Stanley and Capital International -- had bought the shares worth 1.27 billion rupees on August 1.
They later refused to accept the transaction because DSP Merrill Lynch had not informed them the shares belonged to the company's managing director.
Asian Paints is India's leading paints manufacturer.
On Thursday, the Asian Paints share closed 15.60 rupees higher at 329.50 at the NSE. It was up 16.25 rupees at 328 on the Bombay exchange.
